name: ESOP feasibility path
description: A company-owned trust acquires the owner's shares on behalf of all eligible employees. Structured per Employee Ownership Journey v0.2's ESOP exploration path; every seeded value is a starting point for the owner to confirm or replace.

seed_assumptions.name: Shareholder percentage sold to the trust
seed_assumptions.description: The owner's working assumption for how much of the company the trust buys in this path.

seed_assumptions.name: Bank financing covers the purchase price
seed_assumptions.description: ESOP purchases are typically financed by company debt repaid from future cash flow; the working assumption is that a lender will cover the purchase price on those terms.

seed_assumptions.name: Company cash flow can carry the ESOP loan
seed_assumptions.description: Repayment capacity is the load-bearing question of an ESOP path; the working assumption is that current cash flow supports it.

seed_assumptions.name: Owner transition completes in stages over several years
seed_assumptions.description: The owner's working timeline for handing over day-to-day control while the trust owns the company.

seed_unknowns.description: An independent appraisal of the company's fair market value has not been done; every price figure in this path depends on it.
seed_unknowns.required_action: Commission an independent valuation by a qualified appraiser before relying on any price figure here.

seed_unknowns.description: Whether the company's legal form and existing agreements permit an ESOP trust purchase is not yet checked.
seed_unknowns.required_action: Have counsel review the shareholder agreement and corporate documents for ESOP compatibility.

seed_unknowns.description: Whether the workforce wants ownership and can support the governance it requires is unknown.
